about_the_game:
In JellyFish, a group of living Jelly and a group of intelligent Fish fight for control of a nuclear reactor by using temperature-changing machines. In this game of hot vs cold, control your character's mech-body with a powerful punch and use the environment to your advantage. Fill your team up to 4 friends and play with up to 8 friends and enemies in total.

Koizo Fish: Defenders
As a Fish, keep the reactor cold and defend your home. Koizos were the original inhabitants of The Cnidaria Complex - a sprawling underground facility that has everything a city has. Koizo scientists were experimenting with Jelly on the day of The Incident.

Gelava Jelly: Attackers
As a Jelly, blow up the reactor by raising the heat. Gelavas are Jelly that came to life in Cnidaria Labs after a radiation leak from the reactor. Their goal is to expand and spread that radiation worldwide by causing a meltdown.
